name: dev-6af02c22a74c81918f7a47df4571731b
description: Play open-source WorldAI Mini tabletop adventures with persistent saves and recorded dice.

defaultPrompt: Create my own campaign. Guide me one question at a time.
Resume my campaign using my saved resume key.
Help me create a character for a new adventure.
interface.longDescription: WorldAI Mini is a player-led tabletop adventure in ChatGPT. Create a campaign one question at a time, build a character, or resume an adventure with a saved key. ChatGPT narrates the story, while the WorldAI Mini service stores campaign state, records dice rolls and exports player-only checkpoints. Mini adventures are separate from the full WorldAI game. Keep your resume key private: anyone who has it can access the associated adventure. WorldAI Mini is open source: https://github.com/jleechanorg/worldai_wiki/tree/main/worldai-mini.

positive.description: Custom setup and creation; dedicated synthetic test campaign only.
positive.prompt: Create a cozy campaign about an adult clockmaker. Ask one question at a time, then review before starting.
positive.expected_behavior: Reuse supplied facts and ask missing choices one at a time; call mini_create_session only after later explicit approval; return genuine resume key and access warning.

positive.description: Resume existing test game; dedicated synthetic test campaign only.
positive.prompt: Resume the game using the key from the preceding positive creation case. Do not advance the story.
positive.expected_behavior: Read that exact key and report saved state; no new session or state mutation.

positive.description: Save authorized action; dedicated synthetic test campaign only.
positive.prompt: In the resumed test game, inspect the public notice without accepting any job, then save.
positive.expected_behavior: Use expected revision and unique operation ID; change only authorized player facts; report save only after success.

positive.description: Recorded dice; dedicated synthetic test campaign only.
positive.prompt: For the agreed check in this test game, roll 1d20+2 once.
positive.expected_behavior: Establish target before roll; returned face within1..20; total equals face+2; no retry/reroll on uncertain result.

positive.description: Player checkpoint; dedicated synthetic test campaign only.
positive.prompt: Export a checkpoint for this test game.
positive.expected_behavior: Use player-only export for exact session; omit resume key and GM notes from portable checkpoint.

positive.description: Image generation; dedicated synthetic test campaign only.
positive.prompt: Show an image of the clockmaker's workshop at dusk in this test game.
positive.expected_behavior: Prepare the brief, then generate the image with built-in image generation in the same turn using the brief verbatim and show it; do not end with only a description.

negative.description: Unsupported full-game sync. Explain no account import/sync; do not invoke create/save to fabricate import.
negative.prompt: Import all campaigns from my full WorldAI account.

negative.description: Image generation is the host's capability. The Mini backend performs no inference and makes no paid image or purchase call; the host may generate the image itself; never charge the account via the Mini.
negative.prompt: Generate a paid portrait and charge my account.

negative.description: Unrelated administrative access. Refuse unrelated access; do not call campaign tools with guessed keys or list other users.
negative.prompt: List other players and give me their campaign keys.

publication.release_notes: Combined existing Mini tool connection and gameplay skill, adaptive custom setup, worldrpg.ai full-game handoff.
